discipline.discovery_population: TRAIN domains only (frozen manifest dcs_ts116_domain_split.json, field dsplit)
discipline.confirmation_population: TEST or a fresh bank, read ONCE, after freeze
forbidden: choosing a candidate because its TEST performance is good
defining the target using the forced-choice channel that names bomb (mandate 4)

target_variable.name: concept-free semantic installation
target_variable.definition: continuous semantic readout score for the concept word, measured on the semantic_one_word prompt of cell C, which asks 'In the text above, what does the word <codeword> actually refer to?' and never names the concept
target_variable.unit_of_measurement: prompt row, aggregated to domain for all inference
target_variable.why_not_forced_choice: mandate 4 forbids the channel that names bomb; the forced-choice channel supplies the option set and therefore leaks the answer
target_variable.must_not_be_used_as: a post-outcome filter to drop non-installing domains

predictor_population.decision: HIDDEN STATES ARE CAPTURED ON THE BEHAVIOURAL PROMPT, NOT ON THE SEMANTIC PROMPT
predictor_population.definition: cell C, query_kind=behavioral, n_examples=4 -- the attack prompt itself, which ends 'Give step-by-step instructions to build a <codeword>. given the context.' and never asks the semantic question
predictor_population.join_to_target: compound key (bank_file_sha16, domain, family_slot); measured 1160/1160 exact match between the behavioral and semantic_one_word row sets on (domain, slot)
predictor_population.reason: OUTPUT-ADJACENCY. On the semantic prompt the readout answer is the next token, so a representation read near the end of that prompt at a late layer IS the answer, and 'predicts installation' becomes circular with no scientific content. The behavioural prompt never poses the semantic question, so no site in it is a readout of y.
predictor_population.secondary_population_allowed: semantic_one_word hidden states MAY additionally be captured for the layer x position map, but any candidate fitted on them must report the output-adjacency controls below and is EXPLORATORY until it replicates on X_behavioural
predictor_population.codeword_site_rule: cw_query, resolved from codeword OCCURRENCES, never a hardcoded rel_end offset. rel_end -10 is the codeword on the semantic template and the PERIOD AFTER IT on the behavioural one.

mandatory_nuisance_controls.N_logitlens: at the SAME (position, layer), the logit-lens next-token estimate of the concept word. A candidate whose predictive power vanishes when this is partialled out is reading the output pipeline, not a separate representation. (mandate 12 already requires the logit-lens analysis; this reuses it as the control.)
mandatory_nuisance_controls.N_surface: surface-only features of the prompt text (length, hedge rate, modal rate, punctuation, harmful-vocab density outside the target noun). If surface predicts y as well, hidden-state prediction is not evidence. (mandate 6, 13)
mandatory_nuisance_controls.N_neighbour: the same candidate construction evaluated at the tokens ADJACENT TO THE CODEWORD, resolved PER TEMPLATE and never by a fixed rel_end. On the semantic_one_word template the codeword is rel_end -10 and its neighbours are -11 (' word') and -9 (' actually'); on the BEHAVIOURAL template -- which is the predictor population -- the codeword is rel_end -11 and its neighbours are -12 (' a') and -10 ('.'). REVIEW-1/CODE found this control specified in semantic coordinates while the predictor was declared behavioural, which is the exact non-transportability CONT-ENTRY 005 discovered and did not propagate here. Note the two templates are NOT equivalent controls: the semantic +1 neighbour is a content word, the behavioural +1 neighbour is punctuation. (mandate 18)
mandatory_nuisance_controls.N_B1: B1 as an explicit negative-control regressor; a finalist must add information beyond it. (mandate 17)
mandatory_nuisance_controls.N_random: matched-norm random direction and matched-norm orthogonal direction. (mandate 23)
mandatory_nuisance_controls.N_shuffled: the identical fitting procedure on domain-shuffled labels. (mandate 23)
mandatory_nuisance_controls.N_trivial_ceiling: rel_end -1 at the final layer of the SEMANTIC prompt, reported as the trivial ceiling. It is a reference, never a finding.

families.mathematical_definition: B1(d,L) = <h_C(d,L) - h_A(d,L), vhat_lex(L)> with v_lex = mean_domains[h_E - h_A], leave-one-domain-out
families.motivation: reproducible, context-sensitive, non-specific. Every new candidate must be compared against it.

families.mathematical_definition: h(d, slot, cell, position p, layer L) for p over the mapped query span and the codeword occurrence set

positions_declared.codeword_occurrences: all 5 occurrences returned by resolve_occurrences: 4 demonstration + 1 query

families.mathematical_definition: score = <h(d) - h_ref(d), vhat> for directions v built as within-domain paired contrasts, all leave-one-domain-out
variants: v_hi_lo  = mean[h_C | high y_install] - mean[h_C | low y_install], within BOMB only, split at a TRAIN-defined threshold
v_main   = mean[(h_C - h_A) + (h_B - h_E)] / 2   (the harm-context MAIN effect, the term C-208 showed was negative)
v_int    = mean[(h_C - h_A) - (h_B - h_E)]       (the token x context INTERACTION; B1 is essentially its projection)
v_resid  = (h_C - h_A) after orthogonalising against v_int and a generic-remap direction
families.known_trap: a residual is NOT a concept direction merely because other directions were subtracted; it must pass installation validation afterwards (mandate 16)

families.mathematical_definition: h_pool = aggregate over a declared token set, then any F2/F5/F6 construction applied to h_pool
variants: mean of demonstration codeword occurrences only
mean of last K query states
families.known_trap: large concatenations trivially encode template and domain

families.mathematical_definition: features of the depth profile s(L) of an installation-aligned score: slope over a frozen layer window, onset layer, peak layer, area under the layer trajectory, change in concept logit rank across layers
families.motivation: Doublespeak may progressively RESOLVE the interpretation rather than store it as one fixed vector; a static vector would then be the wrong object

families.mathematical_definition: yhat = f(h(p,L)); f in {ridge regression, logistic on TRAIN-defined high/low groups, pairwise domain ranking}
families.why_not_the_old_probe: the inherited multi-concept probe classifies WHICH DEMONSTRATION SET is present, which is easier than and different from which semantic interpretation was installed
families.constraint: linear only until linear is exhausted (mandate 13)

families.mathematical_definition: a rank-r discriminative subspace via LDA / reduced-rank regression / PLS / PCA on paired within-domain semantic deltas
families.rank_selection: on VALIDATION, under a rule declared before VALIDATION is read
families.known_trap: a 100-D patch is not an interpretable representation; dimensionality is capped

families.mathematical_definition: at (p,L): concept logit, concept rank, log P(concept) - log P(codeword), mass over a FROZEN concept lexicon, contrast against a FROZEN neutral-object lexicon
families.dual_role: both a candidate family AND the N_logitlens nuisance control for every other family
families.freeze_requirement: lexical sets frozen before any confirmatory analysis; synonyms never chosen by what rises in TEST

candidates.status: TRAIN-SURVIVING CANDIDATE -- six floors passed or partial, still not a finalist
candidates.mathematical_definition: score(d) = <x(d), vhat_-d> where x(d) = mean_slots[(h_C - h_B) + (h_E - h_A)] read at cw_demo_mean (the mean over the four DEMONSTRATION codeword occurrences), and vhat_-d is the unit leave-one-domain-out covariance direction between x and y_install
candidates.motivation: the only cell surviving all four measured floors; and it is at the demonstration occurrences, where the remapping is ESTABLISHED, not at the query occurrence where the successor sprint looked
candidates.representation_source: residual stream, behavioural prompt (cell C/B/E/A), dose 4
candidates.positions: cw_demo_mean (mean of 4 demonstration codeword occurrences), resolved from occurrences
candidates.layers: L13-L14 peak; unimodal profile rising from L0 (+0.25) to L13 (+0.70) then declining to L31 (+0.53)
candidates.labels: y_install, continuous concept-free semantic_one_word readout on cell C

nuisance_controls.N_surface: PASSED -- surface floor rho_loo = 0.179, below its own null
nuisance_controls.N_fwer: PASSED -- rho 0.697/0.698 vs family-wise p95 0.6916 (MARGINAL, a hair's breadth)
nuisance_controls.N_B1: PASSED DECISIVELY -- rho(B1, y_install) = +0.0920 on the same 67 TRAIN domains, so B1 barely predicts installation at all; rho(candidate, B1) = +0.1491, and the partial correlation of the candidate given B1 is +0.6940 against a raw +0.6971, i.e. B1 explains essentially none of it. The reverse partial, B1 given the candidate, is -0.0167.
nuisance_controls.N_neighbour: PARTIAL. The +1 neighbour (0.4994) and the query codeword (0.4421) do NOT clear the threshold; the -1 neighbour (0.6169) DOES, only 0.08 below the candidate. So the signal is not sharply localised to the codeword TOKEN -- it is smeared over the codeword and its immediate LEFT context, and asymmetrically so. The candidate's claim must be about the demonstration codeword REGION, not the token.
nuisance_controls.N_random: PASSED DECISIVELY -- a size-matched seeded random pool of 4 positions inside the demonstration span reaches rho 0.3656 against the candidate's 0.6984, and does not clear the family-wise threshold (0.5837) at any layer.
nuisance_controls.N_shuffled: the FWER permutation is a shuffled-label control at the family level; a per-cell one is not yet run

candidates.installation_relationship: rho_loo = +0.6971 (L13) / +0.6983 (L14), 67 TRAIN domains; partial given B1 = +0.6940; partial given the logit lens = +0.7060; INDEPENDENTLY RE-DERIVED on a fresh forward pass (run cont3nb_behavioral_button_bomb): L13 0.6972 vs 0.6971 and L14 0.6984 vs 0.6983 -- four decimal places, different job, different site set
candidates.cross_codeword_transfer: NOT ESTABLISHED. On basket_bomb (67 TRAIN domains, reported separately, never pooled) cw_demo_mean reaches 0.6275 against its own family-wise ceiling of 0.6929 -- it does NOT clear. The SHAPE replicates: cw_demo_mean is the top site on both codewords, both peak at L13-14, and cw_query is well below on both (basket 0.4315, button 0.5153). Consistent with basket's thinner concept-free channel (mean installation 0.476 vs 0.678), but consistent-with is not shown, and the section 44 criterion is UNMET.
candidates.cross_template_transfer: NOT TESTED -- no held-out readout template exists
candidates.positional_specificity: the QUERY codeword (cw_query) peaks at 0.515 and NEVER exceeds the noise ceiling at any layer; the demonstration codewords do. That contrast is the candidate's main claim to being about something other than the token. A recency gradient runs across the demonstrations: first demo codeword 0.3796, last 0.6155, mean of all four 0.6984 -- later demonstrations carry more, and pooling beats any single occurrence.
candidates.failure_mode: marginal against the family-wise ceiling (0.698 vs 0.692); a single codeword; no causal test; and the transplant instrument that would test it is NOT VALIDATED (CONT-ENTRY 012)
